##### Project general facts

Firoza is a refined residential development set within Dubai Islands, offering a curated collection of fully furnished apartments, townhouses, and duplexes. The project rises across eight residential floors with a dedicated parking level, presenting a contemporary architectural design defined by clean lines and balanced proportions. Each residence is thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts and modern interiors, creating a seamless blend of functionality, comfort, and understated elegance in a coastal-inspired setting.

The lifestyle at Firoza is enhanced by a selection of well-integrated amenities designed to support both relaxation and social living. Residents can enjoy landscaped outdoor areas, fitness facilities, and communal spaces that foster a sense of community while maintaining privacy. The development’s location further elevates the experience, placing residents within easy reach of beaches, marinas, retail destinations, and essential services, offering a balanced lifestyle between urban convenience and waterfront tranquility.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, ensuring a refined and durable living environment. Kitchens come fully equipped, designed to complement the overall aesthetic while maintaining practicality. All residences are delivered fully furnished, providing a turnkey solution with contemporary interiors that reflect comfort, style, and ready-to-move-in convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a stunning collection of man-made islands designed to redefine waterfront living in Dubai. Spanning over 21 kilometers of pristine coastline, the destination offers breathtaking views and direct access to glistening waters. The area is thoughtfully designed to integrate residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, creating a vibrant community that caters to a dynamic lifestyle while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. With eco-conscious infrastructure and abundant green spaces, Dubai Islands provides a tranquil escape from urban life.

Residents and visitors can enjoy an unparalleled range of amenities, including world-class resorts, marinas, and serene beaches. The islands are a hub for recreation, offering thrilling water sports, yachting adventures, and entertainment options that cater to all age groups. From lush parks to vibrant shopping and dining venues, every aspect of Dubai Islands is crafted to create a luxurious and immersive lifestyle experience.

Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Dubai’s mainland, the area is easily accessible via major highways, bridges, and public transportation links. Key landmarks such as the Gold Souq Metro Station, Dubai International Airport, and Downtown Dubai are within a short drive. Dubai Islands perfectly combines convenience, natural beauty, and modern infrastructure, making it one of the city's most sought-after waterfront destinations.
